class Operator
  hosts() -> HostList
  add_host(expected_revision: str, host: HostEntry) -> HostChange
  remove_host(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> HostChange

  issue_key(program: str, credential: str) -> KeyIssued
  revoke_key(program: str) -> KeyRevoked
  audit(cursor: int, max_entries: int) -> AuditPage
  gateway() -> GatewayState
  set_gateway(expected_revision: str, open: bool, address: str) -> GatewayChange

  revoke_key(program: str) -> KeyRevoked

  gateway() -> GatewayState
  set_gateway(expected_revision: str, open: bool, address: str) -> GatewayChange
